title: Garena Internship 2027
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

Are you ready to be a part of the world’s most popular mobile game company? We are looking for driven students to join our Internship Program 2027, where you will have the opportunity to choose your focus track: Operations or Marketing.

You will be an integral part of our core squad, mastering the product from the inside out and taking ownership of the engines that keep the game alive and thriving. This role is designed to fast-track you, tailored to your chosen path:

Operations Track: You will focus on product execution and live systems. Your responsibilities include managing the in-game economy, planning and executing major regional live events, and using data analysis to optimize player retention and ensure seamless daily game operations.

Marketing Track: You will focus on growth, branding, and player acquisition. Your responsibilities include planning and executing high-impact marketing campaigns, analyzing user acquisition (UA) performance data to maximize campaign ROI, and managing local influencer networks and community strategies to expand and engage our player base.

Our ideal candidate would be able to run with us, adapt to our employees' needs, and stay humble throughout. If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we'd love to work with you!

Make sure to share your CV in English.

Exclusivity contract required.

Requirements

  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or later.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, with proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
  • Passion for games: You must be an active player, have deep knowledge of gaming mechanics, meta-trends, and player psychology.
  • Analytical Excellence: Ability to use data to justify operational decisions and optimize the player experience.
  • Availability: able to work in a hybrid model for 30 hours per week (6h/day) starting January 2027 in São Paulo/SP.

Are you ready to Join the Game? Apply now and show us why you are the perfect fit for Garena.

title: Field Service Engineer - Latin America
description:
Based in São Paulo, Brazil | Full-time | Extensive regional travel

Position Summary

AV Flexologic B.V. is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join its global Service & Support division, based in São Paulo, Brazil. This role provides on-site installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair services for AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, and Central America. The successful candidate will work closely with the Service & Support coordination team (Alphen aan den Rijn, Netherlands) and the Monterrey and Bangkok offices to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across the region.

Engagement structure

This role is structured as an independent contractor engagement: the engineer will operate through their own Brazilian legal entity (CNPJ / "PJ" — pessoa jurídica) and issue a monthly invoice (nota fiscal) to AV Flexologic for services rendered, rather than being hired as a CLT employee.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, and repair of AV Flexologic equipment at customer sites.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues in the field, escalating to engineering or product specialists as needed.
  • Travel regularly within the São Paulo area and across Brazil, as well as to Argentina, Chile, and Central America, for scheduled and emergency service visits.
  • Provide clear, timely reporting on service visits, parts usage, and customer feedback to the Service & Support coordination team.
  • Maintain professional communication with customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
  • Support training of local customer technicians where applicable.
  • Maintain assigned company equipment (vehicle, tools, laptop, phone) in good working order.

Travel Requirements

This is a field-based, travel-intensive role. Expected travel coverage includes:

  • São Paulo metropolitan area and state (base region, most frequent travel)
  • Other regions of Brazil, as service demand requires
  • Argentina and Chile
  • Central America ("Middle America")

Travel frequency will vary by season and customer install base; candidates should expect travel for a significant portion of working time, including multi-day international trips. A valid passport and the ability to obtain visas/work authorizations for the above countries is required.

Candidate Requirements

  • Technical degree or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, or industrial engineering (or equivalent hands-on field service experience).
  • Prior experience in field service, industrial equipment maintenance, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Fluent Portuguese (native/near-native) and working proficiency in English required; Spanish strongly preferred given Argentina/Chile/Central America coverage.
  • Valid driver's license; comfortable with frequent independent travel.
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset, customer service orientation, and ability to work autonomously in the field.

Service Availability & Extra Hours

Expected availability

Equivalent to 40 hours per week

Extra hours beyond scope

Additional hours may be billed as an extra line item on the monthly invoice, or offset with reduced availability in a following period, as agreed between the parties.

Downtime & Public Holidays

Agreed annual downtime

20–25 business days per year with no invoice reduction, by mutual agreement (contractual, not statutory)

National public holidays

9 fixed federal holidays, plus movable holidays (see list below) — no service expected, no invoice reduction

Brazilian national (federal) holidays

  • January 1 – New Year's Day
  • April 21 – Tiradentes Day
  • May 1 – Labour Day
  • September 7 – Independence Day
  • October 12 – Our Lady of Aparecida (Patron Saint of Brazil)
  • November 2 – All Souls' Day
  • November 15 – Republic Proclamation Day
  • November 20 – National Black Consciousness Day (federal holiday since 2024)
  • December 25 – Christmas Day

In addition, Good Friday and Corpus Christi are movable, date-dependent observances, and Carnival (February/March) is technically an optional "ponto facultativo" day rather than a mandatory holiday — in practice, it is observed by the vast majority of Brazilian employers. State and municipal holidays (e.g., São Paulo city/state-specific dates) may add further non-working days depending on exact work location. On request holidays can be traded for work days in mutual agreement.

Compensation (Monthly Invoice)

Monthly invoice amount (indicative)

Based on experience level

Travel expenses

Covered by AV Flexologic for company travel.

Equipment Provided

  • Company credit card for business/travel expenses
  • Company mobile phone
  • Company laptop
  • Company vehicle — to be assessed based on actual travel patterns and territory size; if not provided, a vehicle/mileage allowance will apply for local travel

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

  • Desenvolver análises comparativas (mapas de equalização técnica e comercial) para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Negociar preços, prazos, condições comerciais, SLA's, penalidades e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas internas, normas de compliance e requisitos legais.
  • Identificar oportunidades de redução de custos, captura de valor e mitigação de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Apoiar iniciativas estratégicas de sourcing e desenvolvimento de categorias de serviços.
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com stakeholders internos para alinhamento das demandas de negócio.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Comércio Exterior, logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em compras estratégicas de indiretos - serviços RH, Tecnologia (TI) , Facilities , Mão de Obra;
  • Vivência em processos de concorrência e negociação com fornecedores.
  • Experiência em gestão contratual e acompanhamento de SLA's.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de Strategic Sourcing será considerado diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Técnicas de negociação.
  • Gestão de contratos.
  • Análise financeira e custo total de propriedade (TCO).
  • Conhecimento de tributos aplicáveis à contratação de serviços.

Diferenciais
